\title "Loop edge 02: repeat counts"
\tempo 120
.
:1 0.1 |
// Close without an opening repeats from the start of the score.
\rc 2 :1 2.1 |
// Single-bar repeat played three times.
\ro \rc 3 :2 3.1 5.1 |
\ro :4 0.1 2.1 3.1 5.1 |
\rc 2 :4 7.1 5.1 3.1 2.1 |
// A second repeat directly after the previous close.
\ro :1 0.1 |
\rc 2 :1 3.1 |
:1 5.1
